title: Kopi Pertama di Kota Baru
titleEn: First Coffee in the New City
description: Perjalanan hari pertama tiba di kota baru, mencari sarapan, berinteraksi dengan warga lokal, dan memesan kopi impian.

episodes.title: Selamat Pagi, Kota Baru
episodes.recap: Prolog: Kamu baru saja turun dari kereta jarak jauh di Stasiun Pusat. Udara pagi terasa sejuk dan kota asing ini menyambutmu dengan kesibukan orang-orang yang bergegas berangkat kerja. Perutmu mulai lapar, dan kamu memutuskan mencari kedai kopi terdekat.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: You step onto the busy platform and take a deep breath.
dialogue.idText: Kamu melangkah ke peron yang ramai dan menarik napas panjang.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Welcome to the city! Remember, every journey starts with a friendly greeting.
dialogue.idText: Selamat datang di kota baru! Ingat, setiap petualangan dimulai dari sapaan ramah.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: You adjust your heavy backpack and look around for an exit sign.
dialogue.idText: Kamu membetulkan ransel beratmu dan mencari tanda pintu keluar di sekitar.

dialogue.speaker: Station Officer
dialogue.en: Good morning! Are you looking for the main exit or the taxi stand?
dialogue.idText: Selamat pagi! Apakah Anda mencari pintu keluar utama atau pangkalan taksi?

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana caramu membalas sapaan petugas stasiun dengan sopan?

options.text: Good morning! The main exit, please. Is there a café nearby?
options.reactionEn: Yes, just take the north gate. There is a cozy coffee shop right across the street!
options.reactionId: Ya, ambil saja gerbang utara. Ada kedai kopi nyaman tepat di seberang jalan!

options.text: Hello! I am new here. Where can I find a good cup of coffee?
options.reactionEn: Welcome! Head through the main doors, and look for 'The Corner Cup'. It's the best!
options.reactionId: Selamat datang! Lewat pintu utama, lalu cari 'The Corner Cup'. Kopinya paling mantap!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thank you so much for your kind help!
dialogue.idText: Terima kasih banyak atas bantuan baik Anda!

dialogue.speaker: Station Officer
dialogue.en: You are very welcome. Have a wonderful first day in our city!
dialogue.idText: Sama-sama. Semoga hari pertamamu di kota kami menyenangkan!

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: You walk through the north gate into the morning breeze.
dialogue.idText: Kamu berjalan melewati gerbang utara menuju semilir angin pagi.

dialogue.prompt: Seorang pejalan kaki tersenyum kepadamu. Apa reaksimu?

options.text: Smile and say: 'Good morning!'
options.reactionEn: Morning! Lovely weather today, isn't it?
options.reactionId: Pagi! Cuaca yang indah hari ini, bukan?

options.text: Nod politely and say: 'Hello, have a nice day!'
options.reactionEn: Thanks, you too! Welcome to our neighborhood!
options.reactionId: Terima kasih, kamu juga! Selamat datang di lingkungan kami!

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: Across the pedestrian crossing, a warm wooden sign catches your eye: 'The Corner Cup'. The rich scent of roasted coffee beans drifts through the glass door.
dialogue.idText: Di seberang penyeberangan pejalan kaki, plang kayu hangat menarik perhatianmu: 'The Corner Cup'. Aroma semerbak biji kopi panggang tercium lembut lewat pintu kaca.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Used as a greeting when you meet somebody.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: halo; sapaan ramah saat bertemu seseorang
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Hello! I am new here.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A large town with houses, shops, and industries.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: kota; daerah permukiman besar yang ramai
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Have a wonderful first day in our city!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A container made of cloth or leather used for carrying things.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: tas; wadah untuk membawa barang bawaan
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: You adjust your heavy bag and look around.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To reach a destination at the end of a journey.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: You arrive at the busy central station.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A hot drink made from roasted coffee beans.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: kopi; minuman hangat dari biji sangrai
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Where can I find a good cup of coffee?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A small bowl-shaped container for drinking hot beverages.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Look for 'The Corner Cup' across the street.

grammarFocus.title: Sapaan Santun & Pola Dasar 'Are you...?'
grammarFocus.explanation: Untuk menanyakan kondisi atau arah orang lain secara sopan pada situasi tatap muka, gunakan to be 'Are you...?' diikuti kata kerja -ing atau kata sifat. Contoh: 'Are you looking for the exit?' (Apakah Anda sedang mencari pintu keluar?)

culturalTip.title: Sapaan Pagi & Kontak Mata Hangat
culturalTip.content: Di negara-negara berbahasa Inggris, mengucapkan 'Good morning' kepada orang asing yang berpapasan di jalan atau petugas pelayanan publik adalah norma kesopanan dasar. Senyum ringan dan kontak mata singkat menandakan keramahan dan keterbukaan tanpa dianggap mengganggu.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason the main character is looking for an exit in Episode 1?
options: To catch an airplane at the nearby international terminal.
To find a nearby café and get a warm breakfast after arriving at the station.
To report a lost passport to the local police department.
To return an invalid train ticket to the booking office.
quiz.explanation: Di awal cerita dijelaskan bahwa karakter utama baru tiba di stasiun pusat, merasa lapar, dan ingin mencari kedai kopi terdekat untuk sarapan.

quiz.question: Which response is the most natural and polite way to reply when someone says 'Thank you so much'?
options: No problem at all, I want money.
Please don't speak to me again.
quiz.explanation: Ungkapan standar paling sopan untuk membalas 'Thank you' adalah 'You are very welcome' (Sama-sama / Dengan senang hati).

quiz.question: According to the station officer, where is 'The Corner Cup' located?
options: Inside the underground train basement on platform 4.
Right across the street from the north gate exit.
Ten kilometers away in the industrial suburbs.
quiz.explanation: Petugas stasiun menjelaskan bahwa kedai kopi berada tepat di seberang jalan setelah keluar dari gerbang utara ('right across the street').

quiz.question: What does the word 'arrive' in 'You arrive at the busy central station' mean?
options: To leave and travel far away.
To reach a place at the end of a journey.
To cancel a scheduled train trip.
To buy an expensive return ticket.
quiz.explanation: 'Arrive' berarti tiba atau sampai di tempat tujuan di akhir sebuah perjalanan.

quiz.question: Which question correctly uses Present Simple to ask for directions politely?
options: Where can I find a good cup of coffee?
Where does can I find coffee?
Where I am finding a coffee?
quiz.explanation: Pola modal kalimat tanya yang tepat adalah: Wh-word (Where) + modal (can) + Subject (I) + base verb (find): 'Where can I find a good cup of coffee?'.

takeaways: Kamu berhasil tiba di kota baru dan berinteraksi dengan petugas stasiun secara percaya diri.
Menguasai sapaan ramah: 'Good morning', 'Thank you so much', dan 'You are very welcome'.
Mempelajari 6 kosakata esensial Oxford 3000: hello, city, bag, arrive, coffee, cup.

episodes.cliffhanger: Kamu mendorong pintu kaca 'The Corner Cup'. Di dalam, denting cangkir keramik dan alunan musik jazz menyambutmu. Tapi begitu kamu menatap papan menu di atas kasir, ada puluhan istilah kopi asing yang belum pernah kamu dengar sebelumnya. Bisakah kamu memesan dengan tepat?

episodes.title: Aroma di Sudut Jalan
episodes.recap: Pada Episode 1, kamu tiba di Stasiun Pusat dan mendapat petunjuk dari petugas ramah untuk mengunjungi 'The Corner Cup' di seberang gerbang utara.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: A small brass bell chimes above you as you open the café door.
dialogue.idText: Sebuah lonceng kuningan kecil berdenting di atas kepalamu saat kamu membuka pintu kafe.

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.en: Hi there! Welcome in. Take your time looking at the menu board.
dialogue.idText: Halo! Selamat datang. Silakan lihat-lihat papan menunya dengan santai.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Look at the sizes: Small, Medium, Large. Don't be nervous; ordering coffee in English is fun!
dialogue.idText: Lihat ukurannya: Small, Medium, Large. Jangan gugup; memesan kopi dalam bahasa Inggris itu seru!

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: You step up to the wooden counter. The barista smiles warmly, waiting for your order.
dialogue.idText: Kamu melangkah ke meja kasir kayu. Sang barista tersenyum hangat, menanti pesananmu.

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana caramu memesan kopi dengan sopan menggunakan frasa 'I would like'?

options.text: Hi! I would like a hot cappuccino with oat milk, please.
options.reactionEn: Excellent choice! That's one of our house favorites. What size would you prefer?
options.reactionId: Pilihan yang sangat bagus! Itu favorit kafe kami. Ukuran apa yang kamu inginkan?

options.text: Hello, can I get a cold black coffee and a fresh butter croissant?
options.reactionEn: Sure thing! Our cold brew is brewed fresh every single morning.
options.reactionId: Tentu saja! Kopi seduh dingin kami diseduh segar setiap pagi.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: A medium size, please. Is the pastry fresh from the oven?
dialogue.idText: Ukuran medium. Apakah kuenya baru matang dari oven?

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.en: Yes! The cinnamon rolls came out just ten minutes ago.
dialogue.idText: Ya! Cinnamon roll-nya baru saja keluar sepuluh menit yang lalu.

dialogue.prompt: Barista bertanya metode pembayaran. Bagaimana kamu menjawab?

options.text: Can I pay by card, or do you prefer cash?
options.reactionEn: Both are great, but contactless card is super quick! Just tap right here.
options.reactionId: Keduanya bisa, tapi kartu nirsentuh sangat cepat! Cukup tap di sini.

options.text: I will pay with cash. Here is twenty dollars.
options.reactionEn: Thank you! Here is your change and receipt. Take seat number four!
options.reactionId: Terima kasih! Ini uang kembalian dan strukmu. Silakan duduk di meja nomor empat!

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: You take your seat by the sunlit window. The warm cup warms your cold fingers, and the bustling city street outside looks alive with energy.
dialogue.idText: Kamu duduk di samping jendela berlumur sinar matahari. Cangkir hangat menghangatkan jemarimu yang dingin, dan jalanan kota yang ramai di luar tampak hidup penuh energi.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: What would you like to drink this morning?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To put food into your mouth and swallow it.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Would you like something to eat with your coffee?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A common food made from flour, water, and yeast baked in an oven.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: roti; makanan pokok dari tepung dan ragi
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The bakery makes fresh bread and croissants daily.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Having a low temperature; not warm or hot.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The warm cup warms your cold fingers.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A small plastic card used to pay for goods or services.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: kartu; kartu pembayaran bank atau debit
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Can I pay by credit card?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Money in the form of physical coins or paper notes.
highlightedVocab.idMeaning: uang tunai; uang kertas atau koin fisik
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Do you accept cash or card only?

grammarFocus.title: Frasa Kesantunan: 'I would like...' vs 'I want...'
grammarFocus.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris, mengatakan 'I want coffee' di tempat umum terdengar terlalu menuntut atau kasar. Gunakan frasa santun 'I would like a coffee, please' atau singkatannya 'I'd like...'.
grammarFocus.formula: I would like (I'd like) + Noun / to Verb + please.

culturalTip.title: Kustomisasi Minuman Kopi di Kafe
culturalTip.content: Di kafe modern, barista akan menanyakan tiga hal: Ukuran (Small/Medium/Large), Jenis Susu (Whole milk/Skim/Oat/Almond), dan Suhu (Hot/Iced). Memahami urutan ini akan membuat proses pemesanan terasa sangat lancar.

quiz.question: Why is 'I would like a cappuccino, please' preferred over 'I want a cappuccino'?
options: Because 'I would like' is much more polite and respectful in customer service situations.
Because 'I want' is grammatically incorrect in all English sentences.
Because 'I would like' is only used for cold beverages.
Because 'I want' can only be spoken by children.
quiz.explanation: 'I would like' adalah bentuk permohonan santun (polite request) standar dalam bahasa Inggris, sedangkan 'I want' terdengar menuntut.

quiz.question: Which question politely asks the barista about accepted payment methods?
options: You give me free coffee now?
Can I pay by card, or do you prefer cash?
I am pay money to you.
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan santun standar pembayaran adalah 'Can I pay by card, or do you prefer cash?'.

quiz.question: What is the meaning of the word 'cash' in the dialogue?
options: Money in the physical form of paper notes and coins.
A receipt printed by a cash register.
A discount voucher for regular visitors.
quiz.explanation: 'Cash' merujuk pada uang tunai fisik (kertas atau koin).

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses the adjective 'cold'?
options: He is cold coffee every day.
I prefer cold iced tea during hot summer afternoons.
She colds her hands by the fireplace.
Cold you please help me with the order?
quiz.explanation: 'Cold' berfungsi sebagai kata sifat (adjective) yang menerangkan kata benda iced tea: 'cold iced tea'.

quiz.question: What table number did the barista assign to the main character?
options: Table number one by the entrance.
Table number four by the sunlit window.
Table number ten on the outdoor terrace.
No table was assigned; it was strictly takeaway.
quiz.explanation: Barista menginstruksikan: 'Take seat number four!' yang berada di samping jendela bermandikan cahaya matahari.

takeaways: Kamu berhasil memesan minuman dan makanan kecil di kafe lokal tanpa rasa canggung.
Menguasai pemesanan santun: 'I would like a hot cappuccino, please.'
Memahami perbedaan metode bayar: 'pay by card' vs 'pay with cash'.
Mempelajari 6 kosakata Oxford 3000: drink, eat, bread, cold, card, cash.

episodes.cliffhanger: Saat kamu menikmati tegukan pertama kopimu, seorang pemuda berambut ikal dengan ransel kamera tebal mendekati tokomu. Ia melihat semua meja kafe sudah terisi penuh kecuali satu kursi kosong persis di hadapanmu. Ia menatapmu ragu-ragu...

episodes.title: Boleh Saya Duduk di Sini?
episodes.recap: Setelah menikmati beberapa teguk cappuccino hangat di meja empat dekat jendela 'The Corner Cup', suasana kafe semakin ramai. Seorang pemuda berjaket biru membawa ransel dan kamera profesional mendekati tokomu.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: The morning sun fills the café. Many people are chatting and drinking coffee.
dialogue.idText: Sinar matahari pagi memenuhi kedai kopi. Banyak orang sedang mengobrol dan menikmati kopi.

dialogue.speaker: Stranger
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken? The café is very crowded this morning.
dialogue.idText: Permisi, apakah kursi ini sudah ada yang menempati? Kedai kopi ini sangat padat pagi ini.

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana caramu mengizinkannya duduk dengan ramah?

options.text: No, it is not taken. Please, have a seat!
options.reactionEn: Thank you so much! My name is Leo, by the way.
options.reactionId: Terima kasih banyak! Ngomong-ngomong, namaku Leo.

options.text: Of course! Please sit down. The chair is completely free.
options.reactionEn: Appreciate it! I was worried I would have to drink my espresso standing up.
options.reactionId: Terima kasih banyak! Tadinya kukira aku harus minum espresso sambil berdiri.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you, Leo. I just arrived in this city today.
dialogue.idText: Senang bertemu denganmu, Leo. Aku baru saja tiba di kota ini hari ini.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Welcome! It is a wonderful place, but it can be busy in the morning.
dialogue.idText: Selamat datang! Tempat ini sangat indah, tapi memang bisa cukup sibuk di pagi hari.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Hebat! Kamu telah mempraktikkan etika berbagi meja (table sharing) dengan sangat sopan dan percaya diri!
dialogue.idText: Hebat! Kamu telah mempraktikkan etika berbagi meja (table sharing) dengan sangat sopan dan percaya diri!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A place to sit, such as a chair.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: We share a small table near the window.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To rest with the body supported on the buttocks.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Please sit down and enjoy your drink.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A person you know well and like.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: It is nice to make a new friend on your first day.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Not far away in distance.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Our table is near the front door.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Full of people.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The coffee shop is crowded this morning.

grammarFocus.title: Kalimat Izin Sopan: 'Is this seat taken?' & 'May I...?'
grammarFocus.explanation: Dalam situasi publik seperti kafe atau transportasi umum, gunakan frasa 'Is this seat taken?' (Apakah kursi ini ada orangnya?) atau 'May I sit here?' untuk meminta izin duduk dengan sopan tanpa terkesan memaksa.
grammarFocus.formula: Is this seat taken? / May I sit here, please?

culturalTip.title: Etika Berbagi Meja (Table Sharing) di Kedai Kopi
culturalTip.content: Di kota-kota besar di luar negeri yang padat saat jam sibuk, berbagi meja (table sharing) adalah hal yang sangat wajar. Selalu tanyakan izin sebelum menarik kursi, dan hormati ruang pribadi orang lain selama menikmati hidangan.

quiz.question: What is the most polite and natural way to ask if an empty chair is available in a cafe?
options: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
Why are you sitting alone here?
quiz.explanation: 'Excuse me, is this seat taken?' adalah ungkapan standar internasional yang sangat sopan untuk menanyakan kursi kosong.

quiz.question: What does the word 'crowded' mean in the sentence: 'The cafe is very crowded'?
quiz.explanation: 'Crowded' berarti dipadati oleh banyak orang (ramai pengunjung).

quiz.question: What is the name of the new person who sits at your table?
quiz.explanation: Pemuda pembawa kamera memperkenalkan namanya sebagai Leo ('My name is Leo, by the way').

quiz.question: Which of the following is a polite affirmative reply when someone asks to sit down?
options: Go away, I do not like you.
Of course, please have a seat!
I need all chairs in this room.
quiz.explanation: 'Of course, please have a seat!' mempersilakan orang lain duduk dengan hangat dan ramah.

quiz.question: Complete the polite request: 'May I ______ here, please?'
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal verb 'May', kita selalu menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar (base form / bare infinitive), yaitu 'sit'.

takeaways: Menguasai ungkapan sopan meminta izin kursi: 'Is this seat taken?'
Merespon permintaan orang asing dengan ramah: 'Please, have a seat!'
Memahami budaya berbagi meja (table sharing) di kedai kopi metropolitan.

episodes.cliffhanger: Leo meletakkan kameranya di meja dan melirik ransel besarmu. 'Kamu tampak seperti pengelana yang baru tiba. Dari mana asalmu?'

episodes.title: Dari Mana Asalmu?
episodes.recap: Leo duduk di depanmu sambil menikmati secangkir espresso. Percakapan santai (small talk) pun dimulai, dan Leo tertarik mengetahui asal-usulmu.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: So, where are you from? I hear a friendly accent in your voice.
dialogue.idText: Jadi, dari mana asalmu? Aku mendengar aksen ramah dalam suaramu.

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana caramu menjelaskan asal negaramu dengan jelas?

options.text: I am from Indonesia. It is a beautiful tropical country in Southeast Asia.
options.reactionEn: Awesome! I have always wanted to visit Bali and see the temples.
options.reactionId: Keren sekali! Aku selalu ingin mengunjungi Bali dan melihat candi-candinya.

options.text: I come from Indonesia. I traveled very far to study and learn English here.
options.reactionEn: That is fantastic! Your English sounds very clear and confident.
options.reactionId: Luar biasa! Bahasa Inggrismu terdengar sangat jelas dan percaya diri.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thank you, Leo. What about you? Are you from this city?
dialogue.idText: Terima kasih, Leo. Bagaimana denganmu? Apakah kamu berasal dari kota ini?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Yes, I was born right here. But the people and the weather change every season!
dialogue.idText: Ya, aku lahir tepat di sini. Tapi orang-orang dan cuaca selalu berubah di setiap musim!

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Bagus sekali! Membalikkan pertanyaan dengan 'What about you?' membuat percakapan terasa hidup dan seimbang!
dialogue.idText: Bagus sekali! Membalikkan pertanyaan dengan 'What about you?' membuat percakapan terasa hidup dan seimbang!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An area of land that has its own government and border.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Indonesia is a beautiful archipelago country.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To go from one place to another.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I love to travel to new cities and meet new people.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To gain knowledge or skill in a new subject.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I came here to learn English and gain new experience.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Human beings in general or of a particular group.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The people in this town are very polite.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The state of the atmosphere with respect to wind, temperature, and moisture.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The morning weather is crisp and cool.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Not the same as another or each other.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The architecture here is very different from home.

grammarFocus.title: Menyatakan Asal Negara: 'I am from...' & 'Where are you from?'
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan pola 'Subject + am/is/are + from + Nama Tempat' untuk menyatakan asal tempat tinggal atau kewarganegaraan. Untuk bertanya kembali dengan sopan, gunakan 'What about you?'.
grammarFocus.formula: I am from [Place]. / Where are you from?

culturalTip.title: Seni 'Small Talk' dan Rasa Ingin Tahu Ramah
culturalTip.content: Di budaya Barat, bertanya 'Where are you from?' pada pendatang baru adalah tanda ketertarikan ramah untuk membuka percakapan, bukan interogasi. Cukup sebutkan negara atau kota asalmu dengan senyum percaya diri.

quiz.question: Which question is used to ask about someone's origin or home country?
options: Why do you have two shoes?
quiz.explanation: 'Where are you from?' adalah pertanyaan baku untuk menanyakan asal daerah atau negara seseorang.

quiz.question: What is the correct response to 'Where are you from?'
quiz.explanation: 'I am from [Nama Negara/Kota]' adalah struktur jawaban yang tepat.

quiz.question: How do you politely return a question back to your conversation partner?
quiz.explanation: 'What about you?' atau 'How about you?' digunakan untuk membalikkan pertanyaan secara sopan.

quiz.question: What does the word 'different' mean in Indonesian?
quiz.explanation: 'Different' berarti berbeda atau berlainan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Many people ______ to this city every year.'
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'people' berbentuk jamak (plural), sehingga kata kerja bentuk Present Simple menggunakan 'travel' (tanpa akhiran -s).

takeaways: Mampu memperkenalkan asal negara dengan percaya diri.
Menggunakan frasa pembalik percakapan 'What about you?'
Memahami esensi 'small talk' sebagai jembatan silaturahmi antarbudaya.

episodes.cliffhanger: Ponselmu tiba-tiba bergetar di atas meja. Sebuah pesan masuk dari pengelola kos: 'Kunci kamarmu disimpan di kotak pos Maple Lodge No. 7. Harap tiba sebelum pukul 13.00 WIB!' Kamu melihat jam, tersisa 45 menit lagi!

episodes.title: Peta dan Rencana
episodes.recap: Pesan dari pengelola kos membuatmu harus bergegas. Kamu perlu mencari jalan tercepat menuju Maple Street sebelum pukul 13.00.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Leo. I need to reach Maple Street before 1 PM. Do you know where it is?
dialogue.idText: Permisi, Leo. Aku harus sampai di Maple Street sebelum jam 1 siang. Apakah kamu tahu di mana itu?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Sure! Maple Street is not far. It is only about three blocks away.
dialogue.idText: Tentu! Maple Street tidak jauh. Hanya berjarak sekitar tiga blok dari sini.

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana kamu menanyakan petunjuk arah kepadanya?

options.text: Can you tell me how to get there on foot?
options.reactionEn: Walk straight out of the cafe, turn left at the corner, and walk two blocks.
options.reactionId: Jalan lurus keluar kafe, belok kiri di sudut jalan, lalu jalan dua blok.

options.text: Is it faster to take a bus or walk?
options.reactionEn: Walking is much faster! Traffic on Main Street is very crowded right now.
options.reactionId: Jalan kaki jauh lebih cepat! Lalu lintas di Main Street sangat padat saat ini.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Turn right after the post office. Maple Street is right across from the park.
dialogue.idText: Belok kanan setelah kantor pos. Maple Street berada tepat di seberang taman kota.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Ingat kata kunci arah: 'turn left' (belok kiri), 'turn right' (belok kanan), dan 'go straight' (jalan lurus)!
dialogue.idText: Ingat kata kunci arah: 'turn left' (belok kiri), 'turn right' (belok kanan), dan 'go straight' (jalan lurus)!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A diagrammatic representation of an area of land or sea.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Leo sketches a simple route on the paper map.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A public road in a city or town.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Maple Street is a quiet residential street.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To change direction when moving.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Turn left at the traffic light.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To move at a regular pace by lifting and setting down each foot in turn.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: You can walk to the train station in five minutes.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Toward or on the side of the human body which is toward the west when facing north.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The cafe entrance is on your left.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Toward or on the side of the human body which is toward the east when facing north.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Turn right after the post office.

grammarFocus.title: Memberi & Memahami Petunjuk Arah (Imperatives for Directions)
grammarFocus.explanation: Petunjuk arah menggunakan kalimat perintah (imperative sentence) yang diawali kata kerja dasar tanpa subjek, seperti 'Turn left', 'Turn right', atau 'Go straight'.
grammarFocus.formula: Turn + left / right. / Walk + for + [Distance]. / Go straight.

culturalTip.title: Memahami Sistem 'City Block' di Tata Kota Luar Negeri
culturalTip.content: Di banyak kota mancanegara, jarak sering kali diukur dalam satuan 'blocks' (jarak antar persimpangan jalan). Satu blok biasanya berjarak 100–200 meter.

quiz.question: What does 'Turn left at the corner' mean in Indonesian?
quiz.explanation: 'Turn left' berarti belok kiri, dan 'corner' adalah sudut jalan.

quiz.question: Which phrase means 'jalan lurus terus'?
quiz.explanation: 'Go straight' atau 'Go straight ahead' adalah frasa standar untuk jalan lurus ke depan.

quiz.question: What does Leo recommend as the fastest way to reach Maple Street?
quiz.explanation: Leo menjelaskan bahwa jalan kaki jauh lebih cepat karena lalu lintas jalan raya sedang padat.

quiz.question: Where is Maple Street located according to Leo?
quiz.explanation: Leo menyebutkan: 'Maple Street is right across from the park'.

quiz.question: Complete the imperative direction: '______ right after you pass the supermarket.'
quiz.explanation: Kalimat perintah (imperative) selalu menggunakan kata kerja dasar (base form) tanpa imbuhan: 'Turn'.

takeaways: Mampu menanyakan petunjuk arah jalan dengan percaya diri.
Menguasai kosakata kunci arah: turn left, turn right, go straight.
Memahami konsep jarak blok kota (city blocks).

episodes.cliffhanger: Saat kamu membuka aplikasi peta di ponsel untuk memastikan rute, layarmu berkedip merah: 'Koneksi Terputus - Tidak Ada Sinyal Wi-Fi!'

episodes.title: Koneksi Wi-Fi yang Hilang
episodes.recap: Sinyal internet di ponselmu tiba-tiba putus. Padahal kamu perlu mengecek kode sandi kotak pos hunian kos. Kamu kembali mendekati konter kasir kafe.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Sarah. Could you help me? My phone disconnected from the Wi-Fi.
dialogue.idText: Permisi, Sarah. Bisakah kamu membantuku? Ponselku terputus dari jaringan Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Oh, no problem! The guest network resets every hour. Do you still have your receipt?
dialogue.idText: Oh, tidak masalah! Jaringan tamu direset setiap jam. Apakah kamu masih memegang struk belanjamu?

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana responmu saat Sarah menanyakan struk pembelian?

options.text: Yes, I have it right here in my wallet!
options.reactionEn: Look at the bottom line. The password is printed right there: 'CORNER2026'.
options.reactionId: Lihat baris paling bawah. Kata sandinya tercetak tepat di situ: 'CORNER2026'.

options.text: I think I threw it away. Is there another password?
options.reactionEn: Don't worry! Let me write the new access code on a napkin for you.
options.reactionId: Jangan khawatir! Biar kutuliskan kode akses yang baru di atas tisu untukmu.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thank you so much, Sarah. You are very kind.
dialogue.idText: Terima kasih banyak, Sarah. Kamu sangat baik.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Ingat, huruf 'p' pada kata 'receipt' tidak diucapkan (silent letter), dibaca /rɪˈsiːt/!
dialogue.idText: Ingat, huruf 'p' pada kata 'receipt' tidak diucapkan (silent letter), dibaca /rɪˈsiːt/!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The global communication network.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I need to connect to the internet to check my map.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A secret word or phrase that must be used to gain access.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The Wi-Fi password is typed in capital letters.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To join together so as to provide access and communication.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: My laptop can connect to the cafe network.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A written acknowledgment of having received a specified amount of money or goods.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The access code is printed on the receipt.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Do you have any problem with your connection?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To make it easier for someone to do something.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Could you please help me with the login screen?

grammarFocus.title: Permintaan Tolong yang Sangat Santun: 'Could you help me...?'
grammarFocus.explanation: Kata 'Could you...' terdengar jauh lebih lembut dan santun dibandingkan 'Can you...'. Gunakan frasa ini saat meminta pertolongan kepada pelayan atau orang baru.
grammarFocus.formula: Could you + [verb base] + me, please? / Could you help me?

culturalTip.title: Pengucapan 'Silent Letter' pada Kata 'Receipt'
culturalTip.content: Kata 'receipt' (tanda terima / struk) memiliki silent letter pada huruf 'p'. Pengucapan yang benar adalah /rɪˈsiːt/ (seperti 're-seet'), bukan 're-sep-t'.

quiz.question: Which of the following is the most polite phrase to ask for assistance?
quiz.explanation: 'Could you please help me?' adalah cara paling sopan dan terhormat untuk meminta bantuan.

quiz.question: How is the English word 'receipt' pronounced?
quiz.explanation: Huruf 'p' pada kata 'receipt' adalah silent letter, sehingga dibaca /rɪˈsiːt/.

quiz.question: Where is the guest Wi-Fi code usually found in modern cafes?
options: At the bottom of the purchase receipt
quiz.explanation: Kode akses Wi-Fi tamu umumnya tercetak di bagian bawah struk pembelian (*receipt*).

quiz.question: What does the phrase 'No problem' mean when said by a service staff?
quiz.explanation: 'No problem' adalah ungkapan ramah yang setara dengan 'Sama-sama' atau 'Tidak masalah'.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'My phone can ______ to the guest Wi-Fi.'
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal auxiliary 'can', gunakan kata kerja dasar (base form) yaitu 'connect'.

takeaways: Menguasai permohonan santun dengan modal 'Could you help me?'
Memahami tata cara bertanya kode Wi-Fi kafe lewat receipt.
Melafalkan kata 'receipt' dengan benar tanpa bunyi huruf 'p'.

episodes.cliffhanger: Koneksi ponselmu kembali pulih. Leo menghampirimu sambil tersenyum: 'Hei, sebelum kamu pergi, simpan nomorku. Kalau ada kendala di kota ini, hubungi aku!'

episodes.title: Nomor dan Kontak Darurat
episodes.recap: Leo dengan baik hati menawarkan nomor teleponnya untuk berjaga-jaga jika kamu tersesat atau butuh bantuan darurat di lingkungan barumu.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Here, let me give you my phone number. Just in case you get lost.
dialogue.idText: Ini, biar kuberikan nomor teleponku. Jaga-jaga bila kamu tersesat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: That is very helpful! How do you say your number?
dialogue.idText: Itu sangat membantu! Bagaimana caramu mengeja nomormu?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: It is: zero-eight-one, double two, five-four, nine-three.
dialogue.idText: Nomornya adalah: 081-22-54-93.

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana kamu mengonfirmasi nomor tersebut dengan cermat?

options.text: Let me check: is it 081-22-54-93?
options.reactionEn: Exactly! You got it right on the first try.
options.reactionId: Tepat sekali! Kamu mencatatnya dengan benar di percobaan pertama.

options.text: Could you please repeat the last four digits?
options.reactionEn: Sure thing! The last four digits are five-four, nine-three.
options.reactionId: Tentu! Empat angka terakhir adalah lima-empat, sembilan-tiga.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Perhatikan: orang penutur asli sering membaca angka berulang sebagai 'double two' (dua-dua) atau 'triple five'!
dialogue.idText: Perhatikan: orang penutur asli sering membaca angka berulang sebagai 'double two' (dua-dua) atau 'triple five'!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An arithmetical value expressed by a word, symbol, or figure.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Please write down your contact number.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A device used to transmit sound over a distance.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I save the contact on my mobile phone.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To contact or attempt to contact by telephone.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Call me if you cannot find the door.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To mark letters, words, or other symbols on a surface.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Write the address clearly in your notebook.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A verbal, written, or recorded communication sent to a person.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Send me a quick message when you arrive safely.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To say or do something again.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Could you repeat that slowly, please?

grammarFocus.title: Mengeja Angka & Meminta Pengulangan: 'Could you repeat that...?'
grammarFocus.explanation: Dalam percakapan telepon atau dikte kontak, gunakan 'Could you repeat that slowly, please?' bila ada bagian yang terlewat. Angka kembar sering dibaca dengan awalan 'double' (misal: 22 dibaca 'double two').
grammarFocus.formula: Could you repeat + [noun phrase], please? / Let me check: is it...?

culturalTip.title: Kebiasaan Membaca Angka Nol: 'Oh' vs 'Zero'
culturalTip.content: Di negara-negara berbahasa Inggris, angka nol pada nomor telepon atau nomor kamar hotel sering kali diucapkan sebagai 'oh' (seperti huruf O) selain 'zero'. Keduanya sama-sama benar dan dimengerti.

quiz.question: How do native English speakers commonly say the number pair '22' in a telephone number?
quiz.explanation: Pasangan angka yang sama dalam nomor telepon umum dibaca dengan kata 'double', seperti 'double two' untuk 22.

quiz.question: What should you say if someone dictates a number too quickly?
options: Could you please repeat that slowly?
quiz.explanation: 'Could you please repeat that slowly?' adalah cara sopan meminta lawan bicara mengulangi dengan tempo lebih pelan.

quiz.question: Besides 'zero', what letter sound is frequently used to pronounce '0' in phone numbers?
quiz.explanation: Angka nol sering kali diucapkan sebagai huruf 'Oh' dalam penuturan nomor telepon (misal: 081 dibaca 'oh-eight-one').

quiz.question: What does the word 'message' mean?
quiz.explanation: 'Message' berarti pesan, baik berupa teks singkat, surat, maupun pesan suara.

quiz.question: Choose the correct verb: 'Please ______ your name on the sheet.'
quiz.explanation: Kalimat permohonan/perintah diawali kata kerja dasar (base form): 'write'.

takeaways: Menguasai cara menyimak dan mendikte nomor kontak dengan istilah 'double'.
Memahami pelafalan angka nol sebagai 'oh' atau 'zero'.
Menggunakan ungkapan klarifikasi: 'Could you repeat that slowly, please?'

episodes.cliffhanger: Setelah mencatat nomor Leo, kamu merapikan ranselmu. Saat melangkah keluar kafe, matamu tertumbuk pada plang kayu kuno di ruko sebelah: 'The Scholar's Corner Bookshop'.

episodes.title: Toko Buku di Samping Kafe
episodes.recap: Sebelum melangkah menuju hunian kos, kamu tertarik mampir lima menit ke toko buku klasik di samping kafe untuk membeli peta saku lipat kota.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: A small brass bell chimes above the door as you step inside the cozy bookshop.
dialogue.idText: Lonceng kuningan kecil berdenting di atas pintu saat kamu melangkah masuk ke dalam toko buku yang nyaman.

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.en: Good day, traveler! Can I help you find something special today?
dialogue.idText: Selamat siang, pengelana! Bisakah aku membantumu menemukan sesuatu yang istimewa hari ini?

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana caramu menanyakan peta saku kota kepadanya?

options.text: Do you have a pocket map of this district?
options.reactionEn: Yes, we do! They are right on the front shelf near the counter.
options.reactionId: Ya, kami punya! Peta-peta itu ada tepat di rak depan dekat meja kasir.

options.text: I am looking for a street map. How much is it?
options.reactionEn: This compact pocket edition is only five dollars.
options.reactionId: Edisi saku ringkas ini harganya hanya lima dollar.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Perfect! I will take this one, please.
dialogue.idText: Sempurna! Saya akan mengambil yang ini.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Hebat! Pertanyaan 'Do you have...?' dan 'How much is it?' adalah senjata utama saat berbelanja di luar negeri!
dialogue.idText: Hebat! Pertanyaan 'Do you have...?' dan 'How much is it?' adalah senjata utama saat berbelanja di luar negeri!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A written or printed work consisting of pages glued or sewn together.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The bookshop has thousands of vintage books.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A building or part of a building where goods or services are sold.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: This independent bookshop opened fifty years ago.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To direct one's gaze toward someone or something.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I am looking for a detailed neighborhood guide.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To discover or perceive by chance or for the first time.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Can you help me find the history section?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Low in price, especially in relation to similar items.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The paperback pocket map is very cheap.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The amount of money expected or required in payment.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The price tag is clearly marked on the back cover.

grammarFocus.title: Menanyakan Ketersediaan & Harga Barang: 'Do you have...?' & 'How much is...?'
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan 'Do you have + [Nama Barang]?' untuk menanyakan ketersediaan barang di toko, dan gunakan 'How much is this / that?' untuk menanyakan harganya.
grammarFocus.formula: Do you have [item]? / How much is [item]?

culturalTip.title: Etika Menyapa Pemilik Toko Kecil Mandiri (Independent Shops)
culturalTip.content: Di toko buku atau butik kecil mandiri, menyapa pemilik toko dengan 'Good morning' atau 'Hello' saat melangkah masuk adalah tanda keramahan yang sangat dihargai, bukan sekadar langsung mengambil barang tanpa kata.

quiz.question: Which question is used to ask if a shop sells a specific item?
options: Do you have a pocket map?
Why do you open this door?
Are you eating lunch right now?
quiz.explanation: 'Do you have [item]?' adalah pola baku untuk menanyakan apakah sebuah toko menjual atau memiliki barang tertentu.

quiz.question: What is the proper question to ask for the price of a single book?
quiz.explanation: Untuk harga (uang), kita selalu menggunakan 'How much', bukan 'How many'.

quiz.question: What is the opposite of 'cheap'?
quiz.explanation: Lawan kata dari 'cheap' (murah) adalah 'expensive' (mahal).

quiz.question: What phrase indicates that you want to purchase an item after looking at it?
options: I will take this one, please.
quiz.explanation: 'I will take this one, please' adalah ungkapan natural saat memutuskan membeli barang pilihanmu.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Can you help me ______ the travel section?'
quiz.explanation: Setelah konstruksi 'help me', kita menggunakan kata kerja dasar (base infinitive): 'find'.

takeaways: Menguasai pertanyaan ketersediaan stok: 'Do you have...?'
Menanyakan harga barang dengan tepat: 'How much is this?'
Menunjukkan etika santun saat memasuki toko buku mandiri.

episodes.cliffhanger: Sambil menyerahkan kembalian uang, pemilik toko tersenyum hangat: 'Maple Street ada di gang pintas sebelah tokomu. Jalur itu sangat tenang dan aman.' Di luar, lonceng menara kota berdentang: pukul 12.30!

episodes.title: Janji Bertemu Esok Hari
episodes.recap: Keluar dari toko buku dengan peta saku baru di tangan, kamu kembali berpapasan dengan Leo yang baru saja selesai membereskan peralatannya di teras kafe.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Hey! You got a map from Mr. Arthur? He is a lovely old gentleman.
dialogue.idText: Hei! Kamu mendapat peta dari Pak Arthur? Beliau adalah pria tua yang sangat ramah.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, he gave me great directions for the shortcut to Maple Street.
dialogue.idText: Ya, dia memberiku petunjuk jalan pintas yang sangat bagus menuju Maple Street.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Tomorrow is Saturday. There is a lively farmer's market in the park. Do you want to meet there?
dialogue.idText: Besok hari Sabtu. Ada pasar tani yang ramai di taman. Apakah kamu mau bertemu di sana?

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana responmu menyetujui ajakan bertemu besok pagi?

options.text: That sounds wonderful! Let's meet at 10 AM near the fountain.
options.reactionEn: Deal! 10 AM by the water fountain. I will show you the best bakery in town.
options.reactionId: Sepakat! Jam 10 pagi di dekat air mancur. Aku akan mengajakmu ke toko roti terbaik di kota ini.

options.text: I would love to, but I might wake up a bit late after unpacking. How about 11 AM?
options.reactionEn: 11 AM works perfectly for me! See you tomorrow morning.
options.reactionId: Jam 11 sangat cocok untukku! Sampai bertemu besok pagi.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Luar biasa! Mengusulkan waktu spesifik dengan 'Let's meet at [time]' adalah cara efektif membuat janji temu!
dialogue.idText: Luar biasa! Mengusulkan waktu spesifik dengan 'Let's meet at [time]' adalah cara efektif membuat janji temu!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To come into the presence of or contact with someone.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Let's meet tomorrow at the park entrance.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: On the day after today.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I have an important appointment tomorrow morning.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The period of time between midnight and noon.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The fresh morning air is so refreshing.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A point of time as measured in hours and minutes.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: What time does the market open?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To have the same opinion about something.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: We both agree that ten o'clock is ideal.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To assure someone that one will definitely do something.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I promise I will bring my new camera.

grammarFocus.title: Membuat Rencana & Janji Temu: 'Let's meet at...' & 'See you...'
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan 'Let's meet at + [Jam]' untuk mengusulkan waktu pertemuan. Preposisi waktu yang tepat untuk menunjukkan jam selalu menggunakan kata depan 'at' (contoh: at 10 AM).
grammarFocus.formula: Let's meet at + [Time] + near [Location]. / See you tomorrow!

culturalTip.title: Etika Ketepatan Waktu (Punctuality) dalam Janji Temu
culturalTip.content: Di sebagian besar negara berbahasa Inggris, ketepatan waktu (*punctuality*) sangat dihormati. Tiba 5 menit sebelum waktu yang disepakati menunjukkan rasa hormat kepada kawan atau rekan janjimu.

quiz.question: Which preposition is always used before a specific clock time?
quiz.explanation: Untuk waktu jam spesifik, preposisi yang benar selalu 'at' (contoh: at 10 AM, at noon).

quiz.question: What is a natural phrase to suggest meeting someone tomorrow?
quiz.explanation: 'Let's meet tomorrow morning' adalah ungkapan yang ramah dan alami untuk mengajak bertemu.

quiz.question: What does 'See you tomorrow' mean in Indonesian?
quiz.explanation: 'See you tomorrow' berarti sampai jumpa besok.

quiz.question: What event is happening at the park tomorrow?
options: A swimming race in the snow
quiz.explanation: Leo menyebutkan ada pasar tani lokal yang ramai (*lively farmer's market*) di taman besok pagi.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'We ______ to meet at 11 o'clock.'
quiz.explanation: Subjek 'We' menggunakan kata kerja bentuk dasar dalam Present Simple: 'agree'.

takeaways: Menguasai pembuatan janji temu dengan struktur: 'Let's meet at...'
Menggunakan preposisi waktu yang tepat ('at' untuk jam).
Memahami pentingnya budaya tepat waktu (punctuality).

episodes.cliffhanger: Kamu melambaikan tangan kepada Leo, memanggul ranselmu yang berat, dan melangkah masuk ke gang samping toko buku. Menit demi menit berjalan, dan rumah penginapanmu sudah di depan mata!

episodes.title: Melangkah Menuju Penginapan
episodes.recap: Inilah puncak perjalanan hari pertamamu di kota baru. Setelah memesan kopi sendiri, berkenalan dengan Leo, membeli peta saku, dan berjalan menyusuri gang pintas yang tenang, kamu tiba di depan gerbang Maple Lodge No. 7.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: A white wooden fence and a quiet flower garden welcome you to Maple Lodge No. 7.
dialogue.idText: Pagar kayu putih dan taman bunga yang tenang menyambutmu di Maple Lodge No. 7.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Lihat jam tanganmu! Tepat pukul 12.50 WIB! Kamu tiba sepuluh menit lebih awal dari batas waktu pengelola!
dialogue.idText: Lihat jam tanganmu! Tepat pukul 12.50 WIB! Kamu tiba sepuluh menit lebih awal dari batas waktu pengelola!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Here is mailbox number seven. Let me enter the lock code: four-two-zero.
dialogue.idText: Ini dia kotak pos nomor tujuh. Biar kumasukkan kode kuncinya: 4-2-0.

dialogue.prompt: Gembok terbuka dengan bunyi klik lembut. Apa yang kamu rasakan saat memegang kunci kamarmu?

options.text: I did it! I survived my first day and spoke English with real confidence.
options.reactionEn: I am so proud of you! You handled everything like a true English scholar.
options.reactionId: Aku sangat bangga padamu! Kamu mengatasi segalanya layaknya seorang cendekiawan sejati.

options.text: This golden brass key represents the start of my brand new life here.
options.reactionEn: Welcome home! Step inside, unpack your bags, and get ready for greater journeys.
options.reactionId: Selamat datang di rumah barumu! Masuklah, bongkar kopermu, dan bersiaplah untuk petualangan yang lebih hebat.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: The heavy wooden door opens smoothly into a warm, sunlit room with clean white sheets.
dialogue.idText: Pintu kayu yang kokoh terbuka perlahan menuju kamar hangat bermandikan sinar matahari dengan seprai putih yang bersih.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A building for human habitation.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Maple Lodge is a lovely guest house.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A hinged, sliding, or revolving barrier at the entrance to a building, room, or vehicle.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The room door has a brass number on it.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A small piece of shaped metal with incisions cut to fit the warded parts of a lock.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The room key is waiting inside the mailbox.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To move so as to leave an opening.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Turn the key to open the front door.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Protected from or not exposed to danger or risk.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I feel safe and comfortable in my new room.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: I am happy that I reached my lodging on time.

grammarFocus.title: Refleksi Sukses Hari Pertama: 'I arrived...' & 'I feel ready for...'
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan Simple Past Tense ('I arrived', 'I spoke', 'I ordered') untuk merefleksikan keberhasilan tindakan yang telah selesai kamu lakukan hari ini.
grammarFocus.formula: I arrived on time. / I spoke English today. / I feel happy.

culturalTip.title: Etika 'Self Check-in' dan Tanggung Jawab Kunci Hunian
culturalTip.content: Di akomodasi modern mandiri (*self check-in*), kunci yang diambil dari kotak pos (*lockbox*) adalah tanggung jawab penuh penyewa. Mengganti kunci fisik yang hilang bisa memakan biaya denda yang cukup besar, jadi simpanlah selalu di tempat yang aman.

quiz.question: What is the English word for the metal tool used to unlock a door?
quiz.explanation: 'Key' adalah kunci untuk membuka pintu atau gembok.

quiz.question: What is the opposite of the adjective 'safe'?
quiz.explanation: Lawan kata dari 'safe' (aman) adalah 'dangerous' (berbahaya).

quiz.question: At what time did you arrive at Maple Lodge No. 7?
options: 3:00 AM in the middle of the night
quiz.explanation: Kanci mencatat kamu tiba tepat pukul 12.50 WIB, sepuluh menit sebelum batas jam 13.00.

quiz.question: Which tense is used to reflect on completed actions of the day?
quiz.explanation: Untuk peristiwa yang sudah tuntas terjadi di masa lampau (hari ini), kita menggunakan Simple Past Tense.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'I am ______ to start my new journey in this city.'
quiz.explanation: Frasa 'ready to [verb]' menyatakan kesiapan mental atau fisik untuk memulai sesuatu: 'I am ready to start'.

takeaways: Menyelesaikan hari pertama dengan mandiri dan tiba tepat waktu.
Menguasai kosakata hunian: house, door, key, lockbox, safe.
Merefleksikan pencapaian hari pertama dengan Simple Past Tense.

episodes.cliffhanger: Saat kamu meletakkan ranselmu di atas meja kamar, matamu menangkap sebuah amplop cokelat tebal tanpa nama di samping vas bunga. Di atasnya tertulis dengan tinta hitam: 'Selamat datang, penjelajah. Petualanganmu yang sesungguhnya menanti di Bandara Kota...'
